description: maps.agcom.it: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.agcom.it. Coverage: the area served by maps.agcom.it. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Layer copertura riferita al grigliato INSPIRE 100m, servizio FTTH/FTTB; Layer copertura riferita al grigliato INSPIRE 1000m, servizio FTTH/FTT; Mappa Copertura Congiunta ADSL, FTTC, FTTC+, FTTH/FTTB; Layer Copertura Mobile 4G. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
